validation.verdict: NOT USEFUL FOR TRIAGE. Precision must be read against the 88.3% base rate: no_overlap at 89% is indistinguishable from flagging at random, and sibling_carryover at 100% on n=14 is within noise of the 12.3 fails expected by chance. 14 judged templates matched NO signature and 12 of them failed anyway.
validation.what_this_means: The bank is not a mostly-sound corpus with findable bad apples. The walkthrough layer is defective at a rate where selection carries no information — remediation must be population-wide (regenerate or re-verify all walkthroughs), not candidate-driven.
validation.residual_value: The per-finding detail remains useful for CHARACTERISING a given template during remediation (it names which sibling terms leaked, which descriptions duplicate), but must not be used to choose what to remediate.
